description: This Java class 'DateUtils' provides utility methods for date calculations such as retrieving the current week number of the year, calculating remaining weeks in the year, and checking if dates are in the current year or in the future. It utilizes Java 8's time API and includes an inner non-public class 'TimeUtils' for obtaining current date and time details.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for date computations related to weeks and years.

methods.name: getCurrentWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Returns the current week number of the year based on the ISO calendar, using the current date-time.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of weeks remaining in the year given the current week number.

methods.name: dateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Checks whether a given date falls within the current year.

methods.name: isDateInFuture
methods.description: Checks whether a provided date is in the future relative to the current date.
